repo.description:
### Impact
An account with the `CREATE USER` and a `CREATE VIEW` with `GRANT OPTION` can embed new lines and view metadata into the user name and create a view where part of the user name will be treated as view metadata, possibly causing privilege escalation.

### Patches
Fixed in 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, 13.0.2.

### Workarounds
`CREATE USER` is a high privileged administrative operation, if only high privileged users have it, they won't have a higher-privileged account to escalate to. In most installation this is already the case.

### References
https://jira.mariadb.org/browse/MDEV-40484

### Credis
Ben Bidner (Automattic.com Security Team)
